name: Harmoney Corp Limited
summary: Harmoney Corp Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides secured and unsecured personal loans through online in Australia and New Zealand. The company's personal loans are used for various purposes, including debt consolidation, home improvement, wedding, car, holiday, education, business, and medical expenses. It also operates Stellare, an investment platform. Harmoney Corp Limited was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Auckland, New Zealand.
